scenes.name: The Shift
lines: AI models just got faster, smarter, and nearly free.
AI 模型刚刚变得更快、更强，也几乎免费。
So everyone handed agents their master keys—and crossed their fingers.
于是大家把总钥匙交给了智能体，然后闭眼祈祷。
Prompts leaked. Secrets sat in plaintext. Demos broke by morning.
提示词泄露、密钥明文裸奔，昨夜的演示天一亮就碎。
Because a model is only an engine.
因为模型只是一颗发动机。
We built the entire vehicle—for any engine you choose.
我们造的是一整辆车——适配你选择的任何发动机。
Look around this Singapore office: zero cameras, zero stage crew.
看看这间新加坡办公室：零摄影机，零外包剧组。
This entire launch is running live on the system itself.
整场发布会，此刻正跑在这套系统自己身上。

scenes.name: Through the Glass
lines: Pull straight through the glass—into Street Corner.
穿破玻璃幕墙——欢迎进入街角会场。
Four floating stands, eight tiered rows, and 1,108 atomic-locked seats above Marina Bay.
四座悬空看台、八排阶梯，1,108 个原子锁席位悬停在滨海湾上空。
Eighteen flower mats line the lobby, with Flower Town right around the corner.
十八块花篮垫沿廊排开，转角就是鲜花小镇。
Authored like software commits—and broadcast live across four physical scales.
像提交代码一样构建三维场馆，跨四重尺度实时转播。
In sixty days, fifteen engineers conducting fleets of agents landed 141,624 commits.
六十天里，十五位工程师指挥代理集群落地 141,624 次提交。
Here is the five-layer vehicle that makes speed safe.
下面，掀开让这种速度稳如磐石的五层整车。

scenes.name: Never Hand a Key

chapter.en: Act I — Never Hand a Key
chapter.zh: 第一幕 · 永不交出总钥匙

lines: Rule one: an agent prompt is not a vault.
第一条铁律：智能体的提示词不是保险柜。
Meet NyxID—connect agents to any service without ever handing them a key.
这就是 NyxID：让智能体连接任意服务，却永不接触一把密钥。
Think of a smart hotel keycard: it opens one room until noon, never the master safe.
像一张智能酒店房卡：只开一间房到中午，永远碰不到总保险柜。
Watch it run live. One scoped key for one service, expiring in seven days.
看实机运行：为单一服务签发七天作用域密钥。
The agent calls the API—HTTP 200—while NyxID injects the secret strictly inside proxy memory.
代理发出调用返回 HTTP 200，上游密钥全程锁在代理内存中注入。
Task finished? One command kills access instantly. HTTP 401.
任务结束？一条命令瞬间收回权限，立刻返回 HTTP 401。
Fifty-five built-in services. Forty-two live MCP specs. Zero keys exposed.
五十五项内置服务，四十二份线上 MCP 规范，明文密钥暴露为零。

scenes.name: The Complete Vehicle

chapter.zh: 第二幕 · 整车生态实测

lines: NyxID decides what agents may do. Ornn teaches them how.
NyxID 决定代理能做什么，Ornn 教它们怎么做。
One hundred sixty-three scanned, versioned skills—built as an API for agents, not browsers.
一百六十三项经扫描的版本化技能，专为智能体调用而生的 API。
Your agents start bare-handed and ship fully armed.
让智能体空手进场，全副武装交付。
In the cloud, Apache-licensed CMA v0.12.0 runs isolated sandboxes across six chat channels.
Apache 开源的 CMA v0.12.0 用隔离沙箱接通六大频道。
Credentials hot-reload in two seconds flat—zero reboots.
凭据两秒热重载，全程零重启。
On your own machine, heca runs the AI tools you already use side by side.
在你自己的电脑上，heca 让所有常用 AI 工具并肩协作。
Twenty-seven integrations on one canvas—directed from your desk or your phone.
二十七类集成汇聚一块画布，桌前与手机随时调度。
And chrono-harness replaces wishful prompts with 21 executable Rust judges and 540 Verus proofs.
用 21 个 Rust 判官和 540 份 Verus 证明替代空想。

scenes.name: Your New Workforce

chapter.zh: 第三幕 · 你的 AI 员工团队

lines: Now put real work inside the vehicle.
现在，把真实业务交到这辆整车手里。
Meet nine AI employees covering 85% of real business workflows—102 out of 120.
九位 AI 员工覆盖 85% 的运营流程：120 项中的 102 项。
Front desk, finance, community, HR, admin—each carrying a scoped pass, never the master key.
前台、财务、社群、人力、行政——每人只持作用域门卡，永不碰总钥匙。
Every cash transfer and irreversible commitment pauses automatically for your approval.
凡涉及资金与不可逆承诺，一律自动停在你的审批键前。
Watch our launch arena lock all 1,108 seats with zero collisions.
看发布会场馆现场锁满 1,108 个席位，全程零重座。
Donna's median response: 29 seconds. Four human taps cleared 11 of 12 rehearsal stages.
Donna 中位响应 29 秒，彩排十二关，人类动手四次过十一关。
Our first merchant pilot cohort opens December 17.
首批商户试点，十二月十七日正式开放申请。

scenes.name: One More Thing

chapter.en: Act IV — One More Thing: The Omega Institute
chapter.zh: 第四幕 · One More Thing：可验证的真理

lines: One more thing.
还有一件事。
Why engineer an agent stack this disciplined?
为什么要把一套智能体工程拧得如此严苛？
Because we wanted to stress-test it where nobody can bluff: mathematics.
因为我们要在无人能蒙混过关的终极考场上检验它：数学。
Leave orbit for live.trureturing.org, built by the independent Omega Institute.
离开地球轨道，进入独立科研机构的实时观测站。
Fire a radar sweep across eight orbital research stations—and dive into eight spiral galaxies.
一道雷达扫频掠过八座研究空间站，直潜八座螺旋星系。
Over 223,231 frozen Lean 4 theorems and six million lines of machine-checked proof.
逾 223,231 条冻结 Lean 4 定理，六百万行机器核验代码。
720 hours straight. The corpus tracks 2,278 literature problems, 684 from peer-reviewed journals.
连续运行 720 小时，收录 2,278 道文献问题，含 684 道期刊题。
Same models. Radically different results.
同样的模型，截然不同的结果。

scenes.name: Proof on the Blackboard
lines: Don't take our word for a single theorem—inspect the kernel live.
不必轻信任何一句口号——直接现场核验内核。
A 2025 Physical Review A conjecture capped four-qubit Fredkin gates at two ebits.
2025《物理评论 A》猜想四比特 Fredkin 门上限为两 ebit。
One explicit witness broke straight past 2.00034 ebits—verified by Lean 4 with zero sorryAx.
显式反例击穿 2.00034 ebits，由 Lean 4 内核无占位验证。
Two frozen theorems lock the logic ratchet: every new proof shrinks illusion forever.
两条冻结定理锁死逻辑棘轮：每多一条证明，错觉就永久退后一寸。
Replay Levent Alpöge's November Lean 4 Riemann proof across 8,490 public shards.
通过 8,490 个公开分片，重放十一月的 Lean 4 黎曼猜想证明。
Explore three bilingual monographs and 225 open Mathesis papers. Open questions are marked red.
三部双语专著与 225 篇 Mathesis 开放论文，未决问题标红。
Verified truth in green. Open frontiers in red. Everything reproducible in Git.
已证真理标绿，开放前沿标红，一切皆可在 Git 中独立复现。

scenes.name: Build for What Comes Next
lines: Now pull back across both worlds at once—from eight galaxies back to Singapore's Marina Bay.
现在同时拉远两座世界——从八座星系穿过轨道，飞回新加坡滨海湾。
Intelligence is becoming abundant. Trust is what we build next.
智能正在变得丰裕，而信任，才是我们接下来要造的东西。
Zero-secret custody for your stack. Checked proofs for science. Real AI employees for your team.
给工程以零密钥底座，给科学以机器核验证明，给团队以真正干活的 AI 员工。
Step into Street Corner on December 17 at four p.m. Singapore time.
十二月十七日下午四点（新加坡时间），推开街角会场的大门。
Audit any theorem at live.trureturing.org, try nyxid.ai, or reach us at contact@chrono-ai.fun.
查验任意定理，体验 NyxID，或通过屏幕上的邮箱联系我们。
Pick up the chalk—and build for what comes next.
拿起粉笔——面向未来去造物。
